chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥajjāl, from Abū Isḥāq, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in blowing during salat (prayer) at the place of sajdah (prostration), so long as it does not harm anyone.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection or legal harm
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ السُّجُودِ: the place where sajdah (prostration) is performed

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to blow on the place of prostration during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that blowing at the place of sajdah (prostration) during salat (prayer) is permissible. The permission is conditioned on not causing harm or disturbance to anyone.
